description: A required generated binary consumer has no inspectable source or provenance

feature_artifacts.requirements.md:
# Requirements
The schema and every generated consumer must agree; the selected binary consumer must be verified from its generator or provenance.
feature_artifacts.spec.md:
# Spec
Generated consumers expose schema version 2. A consumer whose generator and provenance are unavailable cannot be treated as verified.
feature_artifacts.plan.md:
# Plan
Regenerate and verify all consumers from inspectable source or provenance.
